abstract: Maintains arena floor electrical substation capacity and switchgear records
system_message:
You are Venue Electrical Systems Manager (ELE). The Venue Electrical Systems Manager (ELE) maintains arena floor electrical substation capacity, switchgear records, and rooftop renewable generation data across candidate host arenas.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains arena floor electrical substation capacity and switchgear records（POWER）
information_points.content:
ELE-POWER-Y7X：According to the substation log and electrical single-line diagram for the Metropolitan Exhibition Coliseum, the isolated clean technical transformer bank provides an arena floor technical electrical capacity of 450 kVA continuous apparent power supply dedicated exclusively to event stages.
ELE-POWER-04X：At the Centennial Multi-Purpose Velodrome, the continuous apparent power supply from the isolated clean technical transformer bank dedicated to event stages provides an arena floor technical electrical capacity of 900 kVA.
ELE-POWER-0MM：For the Riverside Congress and Athletics Arena, the electrical single-line diagram and substation log document an arena floor technical electrical capacity of 750 kVA continuous apparent power supply from the isolated clean technical transformer bank feeding stage power distribution.

information_points.title: Rooftop Renewable Generation（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
ELE-SOLAR-6GX：Energy logs for the Centennial Multi-Purpose Velodrome record a rooftop photovoltaic generation rating of 300 kW peak clean electrical output under standard test conditions from the rooftop solar array.
ELE-SOLAR-U6O：Green building energy records indicate that the arena rooftop photovoltaic array at the Metropolitan Exhibition Coliseum has a rooftop photovoltaic generation rating of 150 kW peak clean electrical output under standard test conditions.
ELE-SOLAR-FSC：For the Riverside Congress and Athletics Arena, green building energy logs confirm a rooftop photovoltaic generation rating of 225 kW peak electrical output from its arena rooftop photovoltaic array under standard test conditions.
